description: On the green tablecloth in front of you are several small plastic plates: a red one stacked on top of a blue one, with other colored plates nearby. The left hand reaches in from the right, grips the top red plate (left-hand object), lifts it off the stack to unstack and sets it down to the right, then slides and separates the remaining blue plate and later brings additional yellow and green plates into view to spread them out.
